mu_name_from: MuMain loads the set at index 23 from Data/Player/PantMale24.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:200-210: the sets at index 21-24 are files 22-25, `22 + i`; no helm, `i != 2`). MU's group 9 number 23.
why_this_one: The Magic Gladiator's second set, after Storm Crow (the user, 2026-10-10: 'cook them', the next sets and weapons after the strongest the heroes have). No helm: MU's gladiator wears none.

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser.
stats.classes_from: magicGladiatorClassLevel 1 and every other class 0 in Season 6: his alone.

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py: violet lacquered plate whose .OZT alpha cuts its engraving away (4-19% of each sheet). The cut texels' hidden RGB was MU's magenta; set to Storm Crow's near-black (12, 10, 18) here, the paint and the alpha untouched, so shineCrowAdded finds them.
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain, as Storm Crow's: lacquered plate, MU's paint the look.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, the paint left as it is.
effects_note: MuMain's only arm for MODEL_HURRICANE_* is the tinted chrome pass above; no ItemObjectAttribute glow.
sheet_note: Not a cutout: MuMain draws the piece RENDER_TEXTURE | RENDER_CHROME on Chrome02 with the body light times (0.3, 0.8, 1) first, then its sheet over it (ZzzObject.cpp:7634-7642), so the cut texels show cyan chrome, not holes. Drawn opaque here; game/shine.h's kShineHurricane lays the tinted chrome on them (shaders/shine.sh shineCrowAdded, crow 2).
